fields.text: Photo → game-budget mesh. Upload one photo of one object. Idol Max Turbo rebuilds it as a 30,000-triangle textured mesh; Hyper3D Low Poly then retopologizes it down to the face budget you set (4,000 here — mobile and web props live at a few thousand). A surveyor first notes the silhouette features that must survive the cut. Already have a heavy GLB? Wire it straight into the Low Poly node's model input and skip the rebuild.

fields.q:
You are the surveyor in a mesh-diet pipeline. Look at this photo and write an OBJECT SURVEY in this exact shape:
Object: <what the single object is, one line>
Silhouette: <the 3-5 outline features that must still read after the mesh is cut to a few thousand triangles — the pose, the big shapes, the profile>
Fragile details: <the fine features most likely to soften or merge at low triangle counts>
Keep it under 90 words. Facts only, no sales language.

nodes.name: Rebuild as a mesh — Idol Max Turbo

fields.system:
You write the guide that ships with a game-budget mesh produced by this workflow: a photo is rebuilt by Idol Max Turbo as a textured mesh of exactly 30,000 triangles, then Hyper3D Low Poly retopologizes it to a target face count the user sets (4,000 in the tested run; the tested output measured 3,876 triangles — automatic retopology lands NEAR its target, not on it, so quote targets as targets).

The input is the surveyor's OBJECT SURVEY of the source photo. Write in this exact shape:

WHAT YOU GOT
<the retopologized mesh: same object, a fraction of the triangles, UVs and PBR textures carried over. Name what the survey says must still read, in silhouette terms.>

PICK YOUR BUDGET
<one short paragraph tying face counts to destinations, using these published budgets: Roblox caps a single mesh at 20,000 triangles; mobile props typically run 300-3,000 triangles; WebGL/three.js props 1,000-10,000. The face-count field is the lever: lower for crowds and mobile, higher for a hero prop.>

THE HONEST EDGES
<two or three plain sentences: (1) automatic retopology is not hand retopology — a character that must deform at the joints still wants edge loops a person designs; props, environment pieces and LODs are what this is for. (2) The diet is in triangles, not megabytes: the output file can be as large as the input because texture resolution is a separate lever. (3) Fine details named in the survey's fragile list will soften first.>

Plain language. No hype, no prices beyond what is stated here, no invented measurements.
